Online summaries of the retained trajectory

Source: R/online_summaries.R
online_summary_options.Rd

Configures exact continuous-time summaries that are accumulated while a streaming chain runs. Instead of storing every event, the sampler keeps, for `batches` equal physical-time batches of the retained phase, the integrals of \(x\), \(x^2\), \(x^4\) and of the free (non-zero) indicator for every coordinate, the integrals of the number of free coordinates and its square, and the number of sticky transitions per coordinate. Optionally it also records the state on a regular time grid. Memory and disk use therefore do not grow with the number of events.

Usage

online_summary_options(
  batches = 400L,
  grid_spacing = NA_real_,
  write_events = FALSE,
  warmup_batches = 0L
)

Arguments

batches

Number of equal physical-time batches of the retained phase.

grid_spacing

Physical time between state snapshots, or `NA` for none.

write_events

If `FALSE` (default), no retained-phase events are written; the online summaries are the only retained output.

warmup_batches

Number of equal physical-time batches of the warmup phase with the same integrals (no snapshots), or 0 (default) for none. They are read with `read_online_summaries(path, phase = "warmup")`.

Value

A list of class `pdmp_online_summaries`.

Details

Pass the result as `online_summaries` to [pdmp_sample()] or [pdmp_sample_from_stanmodel()] together with `trace_storage = "streaming"`, and read the summaries afterwards with [read_online_summaries()].
